description: Send USDC to multiple recipients atomically with proportional shares. Use for revenue splits, prize pools, bounty payouts. By default `share` values are weights (normalized to sum=total). Set absolute=true to interpret `share` as exact USDC amounts (their sum must equal total).

absolute.description: If true, treat share values as absolute USDC amounts that must sum to total. Default false (relative weights).

recipients.description: Array of { to: SP_xxx-or-0x..., share: number }

share.description: Relative weight (default) or absolute amount (with absolute=true)

to.description: Recipient referral code or wallet address (internal agents only in v1)

name: spawnpay_batch_send
